blocks.text: O'zbek tilida maqsadni bir necha usulda aytamiz: «non ol**gani** bordim», «non ol**ish uchun** bordim», «non olay **deb** bordim». Ingliz tilida esa asosiy usul bitta — **to + fe'l**: I went to the shop **to buy** bread. Bu yerdagi **to** — 52-darsdagi want to dagi to bilan bir xil, lekin vazifasi boshqa: u «**nima uchun?**», «**nima qilgani?**» savoliga javob beradi. Maqsadni ot bilan ham aytish mumkin — unda **for** ishlatiladi: I went to the shop **for** some bread.
1. to + fe'l: I went out to buy bread

Biror harakat qilamiz (boramiz, qo'ng'iroq qilamiz, pul yig'amiz) — **nima maqsadda?** Maqsad gapning oxirida **to + fe'l** bilan aytiladi: She phoned the hotel **to book** a room — «xona bron qilish uchun mehmonxonaga qo'ng'iroq qildi». E'tibor bering: o'zbekchada maqsad ko'pincha gap boshida yoki o'rtasida keladi, inglizchada esa odatda asosiy harakatdan **keyin**. to dan keyin doim fe'lning asosiy shakli: to **buy**, to **see** (51-dars).

items.text: Aziz went to the bank **to change** some money.
I'm saving money **to buy** a new laptop.
items.translation: Yangi noutbuk **sotib olish uchun** pul yig'yapman.

items.text: We got up early **to see** the sunrise.

blocks.text: «Why?» (nega?) savoliga javob ko'pincha to bilan boshlanadi — bu qisqa, tabiiy javob: Why did you go to the market? — **To buy** some vegetables. O'zbekchada ham shunday qisqa javob beramiz: «Sabzavot olgani.» Savolni **What ... for?** shaklida ham berish mumkin: **What** did you go there **for**? — «U yerga nima uchun bording?» (savol so'zi va predlog — 46-dars).

items.text: Why are you learning English? — **To get** a better job.
items.translation: Nega ingliz tilini o'rganyapsiz? — Yaxshiroq ish **topish uchun**.

items.text: What did she call **for**? — **To invite** us to her party.
items.translation: U nima **uchun** qo'ng'iroq qildi? — Bizni ziyofatiga **taklif qilgani**.

blocks.text: 2. Ot + to: money to buy, time to rest

to + fe'l otdan yoki something / anything / nothing dan keyin ham keladi va bu narsa **nima uchun kerakligini** ko'rsatadi: money **to buy** food — «ovqat olishga pul», time **to rest** — «dam olishga vaqt», something **to eat** — «yeydigan narsa», nothing **to do** — «qiladigan hech narsa». O'zbekchada bunga «-gani», «-ishga» yoki sifatdosh «-digan» mos keladi.

rows: a book **to read** on the train

items.text: I don't have time **to cook** today.

blocks.text: 3. for + ot: for a walk, for dinner

Maqsad **ot** bo'lsa (fe'l emas), **for** ishlatiladi: go out **for a walk** — «sayrga chiqmoq», come **for dinner** — «kechki ovqatga kelmoq», go to Spain **for a holiday** — «ta'tilga Ispaniyaga bormoq». O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha jo'nalish kelishigi («-ga») yoki «uchun» mos keladi. Ko'p maqsadni ikki xil aytish mumkin: **to have** a coffee = **for** a coffee. Lekin **for** dan keyin hech qachon fe'l kelmaydi: «for buy», «for to buy» — xato.

rows: went to the shop **to buy** bread
went to the shop **for** some bread
went to the doctor **to have** a check-up
went to the doctor **for** a check-up

items.text: Let's go out **for a pizza** tonight.
Dilnoza came to London **for a job interview**.

blocks.text: **for + -ing** ham uchraydi, lekin boshqa ma'noda — **narsaning vazifasi**: This knife is **for cutting** bread — «Bu pichoq non kesish uchun». Kishining maqsadi uchun esa doim **to**: I went out **to buy** bread («for buying» emas). Rasmiy matnda **in order to** ham uchraydi: We left early **in order to catch** the train — ma'nosi to bilan bir xil.

**wait** fe'li uchta qolipda keladi. **wait for** + kishi yoki narsa: I'm waiting **for** the bus — «avtobusni kutyapman». **wait to** + fe'l: We're waiting **to see** the doctor — «shifokor qabuliga kirishni kutyapmiz». **wait for** + kishi/narsa + **to** + fe'l (53-darsdagi want you to ga o'xshash): We're waiting **for** the rain **to stop** — «yomg'ir tinishini kutyapmiz». O'zbekchada: «avtobus**ni** kutyapman», «avtobus**ning** kelishini kutyapman».

items.text: Hurry up — everyone **is waiting for** you!
We**'re waiting for** the water **to boil**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I went to the shop for buy bread.» → **to buy** bread; «I came here for to study.» → **to study** (for va to birga kelmaydi); «I came for study.» → **to study** yoki **for my studies**; «I went for swimming.» → **I went swimming** (55-dars) yoki **I went for a swim**; «I'm waiting the bus.» → **I'm waiting for the bus.** (wait dan keyin for shart); «Wait me!» → **Wait for me!**

Eslab qolish: «**nima qilgani?**» → **to** + fe'l (to buy, to see, to study). «**nimaga?**» → **for** + ot (for bread, for a walk, for dinner). for dan keyin hech qachon fe'lning asosiy shakli kelmaydi.

examples.title: **to** + verb: going somewhere **to** do something
examples.description: Nega biror joyga boramiz? to + fe'l maqsadni ko'rsatadi: went to the market **to buy** melons — «qovun **olgani** bordi», «qovun **olish uchun** bordi».

sentences.text: Yesterday I went to the market **to buy** melons for the guests.
sentences.translation: Kecha mehmonlar uchun qovun **olgani** bozorga bordim.

sentences.text: Madina came to London **to study** design.
sentences.translation: Madina Londonga dizayn **o'qish uchun** keldi.

sentences.text: We're going to the station **to meet** my uncle.
sentences.translation: Amakimni **kutib olgani** vokzalga ketyapmiz.

sentences.text: Every morning Bekzod goes to the park **to walk** his dog.
sentences.translation: Har kuni ertalab Bekzod itini **sayr qildirish uchun** parkka boradi.

sentences.text: Sarah has gone to the bank **to get** some money.
sentences.translation: Sara **pul olgani** bankka ketgan.

sentences.text: Many tourists come to Samarkand **to see** the Registan.
sentences.translation: Ko'plab sayyohlar Registonni **ko'rish uchun** Samarqandga kelishadi.

sentences.text: Dad went out **to get** a newspaper and some milk.
sentences.translation: Dadam gazeta va sut **olib kelgani** chiqdi.

sentences.text: Next summer James is going to Spain **to learn** Spanish.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yozda Jeyms ispan tilini **o'rganish uchun** Ispaniyaga boradi.

sentences.text: Last week my cousin flew to Istanbul **to visit** a friend.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta amakivachcham do'stini **ko'rgani** Istanbulga uchib ketdi.

sentences.text: The children ran into the kitchen **to see** what smelled so good.
sentences.translation: Bolalar nima bunchalik yoqimli hid taratayotganini **ko'rish uchun** oshxonaga yugurib kirishdi.

examples.title: Why ...? — **To** ...: short answers
examples.description: «Why?» (nega?) yoki «What ... for?» savoliga qisqa javob to + fe'l bilan boshlanadi: Why did you call? — **To say** hello. O'zbekchada: «Salom bergani.»

sentences.text: Why are you saving money? — **To buy** a car.
sentences.translation: Nega pul yig'yapsiz? — Mashina **sotib olish uchun**.

sentences.text: What did Aziz go to Tashkent for? — **To find** a job.
sentences.translation: Aziz Toshkentga nima uchun ketdi? — Ish **topgani**.

sentences.text: Why do you get up so early? — **To have** time for sport.
sentences.translation: Nega bunchalik erta turasiz? — Sportga vaqtim **bo'lishi uchun**.

sentences.text: So why are you studying so hard? — **To get** into a good university.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, nega bunchalik qattiq o'qiyapsiz? — Yaxshi universitetga **kirish uchun**.

sentences.text: You called me last night — why? — Just **to say** hello.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun qo'ng'iroq qilibsiz — nega? — Shunchaki salom **bergani**.

sentences.text: What are you going to the post office for? — **To send** a parcel to my sister.
sentences.translation: Pochtaga nima uchun boryapsiz? — Singlimga posilka **jo'natgani**.

sentences.text: And why did they stop at the petrol station? — **To get** some petrol.
sentences.translation: Ular nega yoqilg'i shoxobchasida to'xtashdi? — Benzin **quyish uchun**.

sentences.text: Tell me, why are you wearing your best suit? — **To look** smart at the interview.
sentences.translation: Ayting-chi, nega eng yaxshi kostyumingizni kiydingiz? — Suhbatda chiroyli **ko'rinish uchun**.

sentences.text: But why did Dilnoza open the window? — **To let** some fresh air in.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza derazani nega ochdi? — Xonaga toza havo **kirishi uchun**.

sentences.text: Why do tourists come to Bukhara? — Mostly **to see** its old mosques and markets.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar Buxoroga nega kelishadi? — Asosan qadimiy masjidlari va bozorlarini **ko'rish uchun**.

examples.title: **to** + verb after other actions
examples.description: Maqsad faqat «borish» bilan emas: har qanday harakatdan keyin to + fe'l «nima maqsadda?» savoliga javob beradi: I use my phone **to pay** — «**to'lash uchun** ishlataman».

sentences.text: I use my phone **to pay** for almost everything.
sentences.translation: Deyarli hamma narsaga **to'lash uchun** telefonimdan foydalanaman.

sentences.text: Sarah phoned the hotel **to book** a room for two nights.
sentences.translation: Sara ikki kechaga xona **bron qilish uchun** mehmonxonaga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: We need a ladder **to reach** the top shelf.
sentences.translation: Yuqori tokchaga **yetish uchun** narvon kerak.

sentences.text: Bekzod borrowed some money from his brother **to pay** the rent.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ijara haqini **to'lash uchun** akasidan qarz oldi.

sentences.text: Emma wrote everything down **to remember** it.
sentences.translation: Emma hammasini **eslab qolish uchun** yozib qo'ydi.

sentences.text: My grandparents sold their old house **to buy** a flat in the city centre.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim shahar markazidan kvartira **olish uchun** eski uylarini sotishdi.

sentences.text: Every evening Dilnoza reads to her son **to help** him fall asleep.
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun Dilnoza o'g'li **uxlab qolishi uchun** unga kitob o'qib beradi.

sentences.text: The city closed the road **to repair** the bridge.
sentences.translation: Ko'prikni **ta'mirlash uchun** shahar hokimiyati yo'lni yopdi.

sentences.text: James got up early **to catch** the first train to Manchester.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Manchesterga ketadigan birinchi poyezdga **ulgurish uchun** erta turdi.

sentences.text: Do you use a dictionary **to check** new words, or an app?
sentences.translation: Yangi so'zlarni **tekshirish uchun** lug'atdan foydalanasizmi yoki ilovadan?

examples.title: Noun + **to**: money **to buy**, time **to read**
examples.description: Ot yoki olmoshdan keyin to + fe'l — bu narsa nima uchun kerakligini bildiradi: time **to talk**, something **to eat**, nothing **to do**. O'zbekchada: «yeydigan narsa», «gaplashishga vaqt».

sentences.text: I'm hungry. Is there anything **to eat**?
sentences.translation: Qornim och. **Yeydigan** biror narsa bormi?

sentences.text: Sorry, I don't have time **to talk** right now.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hozir **gaplashishga** vaqtim yo'q.

sentences.text: There's nothing **to do** in this village in the evening.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun bu qishloqda **qiladigan** hech narsa yo'q.

sentences.text: Madina needs some money **to pay** for her driving lessons.
sentences.translation: Madinaga haydovchilik darslari uchun **to'lashga** pul kerak.

sentences.text: Could you give me something **to drink**, please?
sentences.translation: Menga **ichgani** biror narsa bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: We're looking for a quiet place **to stay** near the beach.
sentences.translation: Sohil yaqinida **turish uchun** tinch joy qidiryapmiz.

sentences.text: Tom brought a book **to read** on the plane.
sentences.translation: Tom samolyotda **o'qish uchun** kitob olib keldi.

sentences.text: It's a perfect day **to have** a picnic in the mountains.
sentences.translation: Bugun tog'larda **piknik qilish uchun** ajoyib kun.

sentences.text: My grandfather has a lot of stories **to tell** about his childhood.
sentences.translation: Bobomning bolaligi haqida **aytib beradigan** ko'p hikoyalari bor.

sentences.text: In two days we didn't have time **to visit** all the museums in London.
sentences.translation: Ikki kunda Londondagi hamma muzeylarga **borishga** vaqtimiz bo'lmadi.

examples.title: **for** + noun: **for** a walk, **for** dinner
examples.description: Maqsadni ot bilan ham aytish mumkin — unda **for** ishlatiladi: go out **for** a walk, come **for** dinner, go to Turkey **for** a holiday. for dan keyin fe'l emas, ot keladi.

sentences.text: Let's go out **for a walk** after dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatdan keyin **sayrga** chiqaylik.

sentences.text: Would you like to come to our house **for dinner** on Sunday?
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kuni bizga **kechki ovqatga** kelasizmi?

sentences.text: We went to Turkey **for a holiday** last year.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili **ta'tilga** Turkiyaga bordik.

sentences.text: I'm going to the shop **for some bread**.
sentences.translation: Do'konga **non olgani** chiqyapman.

sentences.text: Aziz is in Moscow **for a job interview**.
sentences.translation: Aziz Moskvaga **ish suhbatiga** borgan.

sentences.text: Shall we stop **for a coffee**? We've been on the road for hours.
sentences.translation: **Qahva ichish uchun** to'xtaymizmi? Bir necha soatdan beri yo'ldamiz.

sentences.text: What did you have **for breakfast** this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **nonushtaga** nima yedingiz?

sentences.text: Sarah went to the doctor **for a check-up**.
sentences.translation: Sara shifokorga **ko'rikdan o'tgani** bordi.

sentences.text: Thousands of people come to Tashkent every year **for business**.
sentences.translation: Har yili minglab odamlar Toshkentga **ish yuzasidan** kelishadi.

sentences.text: Excuse me, is this the queue **for tickets**?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu **chipta uchun** navbatmi?

examples.title: **to** + verb or **for** + noun?
examples.description: Bitta gapda ikkalasi: fe'l bilan maqsad (**to see**) va ot bilan maqsad (**for** a holiday). «for to buy», «for buy» — xato.

sentences.text: I'm not here **for a holiday** — I'm here **to work**.
sentences.translation: Men bu yerga **dam olishga** emas, **ishlagani** kelganman.

sentences.text: Are you going out **for a run** or **to meet** your friends?
sentences.translation: **Yugurgani** chiqyapsizmi yoki do'stlaringiz bilan **uchrashgani**mi?

sentences.text: Dad went to town **for a new suit** and **to get** a haircut.
sentences.translation: Dadam **yangi kostyum olgani** va **soch oldirgani** shaharga ketdi.

sentences.text: Bekzod didn't come **for the food** — he came **to see** Madina!
sentences.translation: Bekzod **ovqat uchun** emas, Madinani **ko'rgani** kelgan!

sentences.text: Is this money **for a present** or **to pay** for the tickets?
sentences.translation: Bu pul **sovg'a uchun**mi yoki chiptalarga **to'lash uchun**mi?

sentences.text: Tom came to Tashkent **for a conference** and stayed an extra day **to see** the city.
sentences.translation: Tom Toshkentga **konferensiyaga** keldi va shaharni **ko'rish uchun** yana bir kun qoldi.

sentences.text: My daughter needs a new laptop **for school** — she uses it **to do** her homework.
sentences.translation: Qizimga **maktab uchun** yangi noutbuk kerak — u uy vazifasini **bajarish uchun** undan foydalanadi.

sentences.text: Emma phoned the restaurant **for some information** and **to book** a table.
sentences.translation: Emma **ma'lumot olish** va stol **bron qilish uchun** restoranga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

sentences.text: We met in town **for dinner** and then went to the stadium **to watch** the match.
sentences.translation: Shaharda **kechki ovqatga** uchrashdik, keyin **o'yinni ko'rgani** stadionga bordik.

sentences.text: Grandma went into hospital **for an operation**, and we all went **to visit** her.
sentences.translation: Buvim **operatsiyaga** shifoxonaga yotdi, biz hammamiz uni **ko'rgani** bordik.

examples.title: **wait for**, **wait to**, **wait for** sb **to**
examples.description: wait for + ot (kimni / nimani kutmoq), wait to + fe'l (biror ishni qilishni kutmoq), wait for + kishi + to + fe'l (kimdir nimadir qilishini kutmoq).

sentences.text: I'm **waiting for** the number 12 bus.
sentences.translation: 12-avtobusni **kutyapman**.

sentences.text: We**'re waiting for** the rain **to stop**.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **tinishini kutyapmiz**.

sentences.text: Madina is **waiting to see** the doctor.
sentences.translation: Madina shifokor **qabuliga kirishni kutyapti**.

sentences.text: Don't **wait for** me — I'll be late.
sentences.translation: Meni **kutmang** — kechikaman.

sentences.text: I **can't wait to see** you again!
sentences.translation: Seni yana **ko'rishni** intiqlik bilan **kutyapman**!

sentences.text: How long did you **wait for** the taxi?
sentences.translation: Taksini qancha **kutdingiz**?

sentences.text: The children **are waiting for** their mother **to come** home.
sentences.translation: Bolalar onasining uyga **qaytishini kutishyapti**.

sentences.text: Everyone **was waiting for** the film **to start**, but the lights were still on.
sentences.translation: Hamma filmning **boshlanishini kutayotgan edi**, lekin chiroqlar hali ham yoniq edi.

sentences.text: Sarah **waited** for an hour **to buy** tickets for the concert.
sentences.translation: Sara konsertga chipta **olish uchun** bir soat **kutdi**.

sentences.text: James **is waiting for** his visa **to arrive** before he books his flight.
sentences.translation: Jeyms aviachipta olishdan oldin vizasi **kelishini kutyapti**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a trip to London
examples.description: Suhbatda maqsadning barcha shakllari: to + fe'l, for + ot, ot + to (a place to stay).

sentences.text: — Are you going to London **for work** or **for a holiday**?
sentences.translation: — Londonga **ish bilan** ketyapsanmi yoki **dam olishga**mi?

sentences.text: — Both! I'm going **to visit** a client, and then I'm staying a few days **to relax**.
sentences.translation: — Ikkalasi ham! Mijozni **ko'rgani** boryapman, keyin **dam olish uchun** bir necha kun qolaman.

sentences.text: — Nice. Have you found a place **to stay**?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. **Turadigan** joy topdingmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, my cousin has a flat in Oxford, and I can take the train **to get** to London.
sentences.translation: — Ha, amakivachchamning Oksfordda kvartirasi bor, Londonga **borish uchun** poyezdga chiqaman.

sentences.text: — Will you have time **to see** the British Museum?
sentences.translation: — Britaniya muzeyini **ko'rishga** vaqting bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: — I hope so. I also want to go to Camden Market **for some souvenirs**.
sentences.translation: — Umid qilaman. Yana Kamden bozoriga **esdalik sovg'alari uchun** bormoqchiman.

sentences.text: — Don't forget to go to a café **for a real English breakfast**!
sentences.translation: — Haqiqiy **ingliz nonushtasi uchun** kafega borishni unutma!

sentences.text: — Good idea! I'm going to the bank tomorrow **to change** some money.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr! Ertaga pul **almashtirgani** bankka boraman.

sentences.text: — You can also use your card **to pay** almost everywhere in London.
sentences.translation: — Londonda deyarli hamma joyda **to'lash uchun** kartangdan ham foydalansang bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Really? Then I'll just take a little cash **for the taxi**.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Unda **taksi uchun** ozgina naqd pul olaman.
